name: Thai eggplant
description: Golf-ball green aubergines quartered into curries — crisp and faintly bitter.

tcm.note: Read with eggplant, which is cool in TCM.

ayurveda.note: Vrintaka is ushna in the classical reading.

unani.note: Baingan is garam in the eastern reading.

histamine.note: Aubergine sits high on the SIGHI list whatever its size or colour.
